reason: 99 baht isn't the problem, I spend more than that on lunch. I already cook my Sunday batch from free YouTube and TikTok clips and it turns out fine, so I don't see why I'd pay to learn dishes I can watch for free.
objection: I can watch a free video for every one of these dishes, and I'm not convinced an app with a cartoon elephant telling me the steps does better than watching a real person cook it.
would_change_my_mind: Let me try one full Sunday plan for free: three dishes and one shopping list for my actual week. The free dishes are single dishes, so I can't test the one part built for how I cook. If that plan saved me the planning and the guessing at the market, 99 baht would be an easy yes.
